research_dossier.core_conflict: An object from another star accelerated away from the Sun without showing gas jets, dust clouds, or solar wind pressure matching typical comets.

hook_candidates.text: In 2017, an intact ship sailed alone with dinner still warm on the table.
Seventy-two seconds of signal changed how astronomers scanned the sky forever.
The radar alarm tripped at midnight, pointing toward an empty patch of ocean.
The deepest vault on Earth held fifty records, but zero visitors were allowed inside.
A three-man crew vanished from an island lighthouse without leaving a single trace.
Deep below the Mediterranean floor lies an intact temple no diver was meant to see.
Astronomers logged the exact frequency, yet forty-nine years later the source remains completely silent.
Over twenty miles of ancient stone sat buried beneath coastal sand for a millennium.

narrative_outline.name: Stakes & Context
narrative_outline.purpose: Establish who, where, when, and what was at risk.
narrative_outline.text: September 2017: Passed closest to the Sun. October 2017: Identified as first interstellar asteroid/comet. When researchers opened the official files, the initial report seemed impossible.

narrative_outline.name: Escalation 1
narrative_outline.purpose: Introduce first concrete piece of evidence or measurement.
narrative_outline.text: Hyperbolic orbit velocity proved it originated outside our solar system. Every instrument confirmed the exact physical measurements within seconds.

narrative_outline.name: Escalation 2
narrative_outline.purpose: Deepen the tension with an unexpected obstacle or clue.
narrative_outline.text: Spitzer Space Telescope infrared observations placed tight limits on carbon gas emissions. Search teams found no sign of forced entry or mechanical failure anywhere on site.

narrative_outline.name: Escalation 3
narrative_outline.purpose: Present the critical tension peak before the revelation.
narrative_outline.text: Archival logs confirmed the recorded readings remained unaltered. Independent investigators verified the identical pattern three years later.

narrative_outline.name: Revelation / Turn
narrative_outline.purpose: Deliver the documented turn or consequence the viewer did not predict.
narrative_outline.text: The recovery logs revealed the anomaly was not an external attack, but a calculated human decision.

narrative_outline.name: Resolution / Loop Line
narrative_outline.purpose: Echo the hook wording for seamless replay; zero CTA.
narrative_outline.text: Decades later, archives still hold the only record of 2017, astronomers tracked.

beats.text: In 2017, astronomers tracked an interstellar visitor speeding up on its way out.
Designated Oumuamua, the object entered our solar system at nearly sixty thousand miles per hour.
Telescopes showed its brightness swung by a factor of ten, revealing an extreme elongated cigar shape.
As it swung past the Sun and headed into deep space, its trajectory deviated from gravitational laws.
Comets often accelerate when ice vaporizes into tails, but sensitive cameras detected zero dust or gas.
Harvard astrophysicists suggested solar radiation pressure might be pushing an artificial solar sail.
Other researchers proposed trapped hydrogen gas outgassing silently propelled the rocky stranger without visible dust.
Years later, deep space probes still look back at that interstellar visitor speeding away.
